title: Consolidate rules and SRD source-data layout
description: The codebase currently has both rules and srd concepts. As deterministic rules-pack ingestion lands, consolidate raw SRD/source artifacts, generated data, importers, and pack loaders into a clearer rules-pack layout.
acceptance_criteria:
- rules vs srd responsibilities are documented.
- generated/source/importer data has a clear location.
- parallel or confusing subsystem names are reduced.
- Existing rules lookup behavior remains stable.
- Coordinates with deterministic rules-pack ingestion epic.
notes: PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/89 opened on refactor/consolidate-rules-srd-layout. Moved packages/core/src/srd/ -> packages/core/src/rules/srd/ (3 file renames, 100% similarity). Added packages/core/src/rules/README.md documenting pack-model files, in-memory base-pack constants and their 0m9 importer replacements, the legacy srd/ catalog retirement path (blocked on 0m9.5), on-disk pack layout, and ADR 0007 pointer. No symbols renamed; no behavior change. typecheck + biome ci + 587/3 vitest all clean.
close_reason: Merged via PR #89 (squash, 02bf127). srd/ moved under rules/srd/, rules/README.md added documenting pack model, legacy SRD retirement path, on-disk pack layout, and ADR 0007 pointer. No symbol renames or behavior changes.
